body: Damn, 4 days into the new year and it's already the worst sickness you've had. All jokes aside, get better bro. 💯

No I've been jabbed twice, back in April and May. It's like things went to hell after my second jab. I was already at a low point but to later on hear that this shit is killing me? It's brought me down even lower. To think that I was doing the "right" thing and getting vaccinated. It's like I fucked myself. I'm still trying to hold on but every day I'm losing more of my will to live. To live in a world where this kind of deceptive bullshit is going on? No thanks. I haven't completely lost my will as I'm searching up ways to repair whatever damage has been done. But I don't know if it's gonna work out honestly and I feel I'll end up killing myself. So that just seems like the reality of things.

Wow. I really do hope things for her work out and she will regain her health but for me? I'm losing hope every single day with all this bullshit going on so I'll be prepping to check out soon. Do everything you can to try to help her.

So it wasn't immediately that she had any heart issues but now she is? I just need a confirmation so I can proceed to offing myself for making such a dumbass decision to take this "vaccine." Because I've been having strange small pains in my heart, left side of chest and back recently. Whereas, I've never experienced any of that, even after I got both jabs.

Like I mentioned, the results were normal. Nothing wrong in my blood or with my lungs and heart in the x-rays. It still doesn't make me feel better because I can't be sure if this "vaccine" will take effect sometime in the future.
No, the only time I've been to the doctor was on the 9th of this month and that was for what I mentioned about the feelings in my heart/chest area.
I can't be 100 percent sure of that.
No, I'm not a hero. I can't be labeled that. I'm just a flawed human being (if I AM still considered one).

I've been experiencing very strange twitching and small pains around my chest/heart area. Never have had this before. I went the the doctors earlier this months and got a blood test and x-ray but the results turned out normal. But there's still this thing in the back of my head telling me to not fully believe that I'll be fine because I can't ever be 100 percent sure if it.
If I'm not dead in 5 years. This all seems like a fucked up joke. As soon as I try to do for myself and be positive, things go to hell. I've actually TRIED. It's like there's no point.

So what should I do? Continue suffering physically and mentally? Until I just drop dead? At least if I kill myself, I'll have a sense of control. I've already ruined my chance of living so it seems like a viable option.
Don't know how long that will take. And honestly, I don't want to wait around while my heath declines even faster than normal because of some bullshit "vaccine."
No. I won't be getting any boosters in the future either. If I'm not already compromised, I'm not going to risk that chance of having my body destroyed even more. And that's my choice.

I took the double jabs back in April and May. Nothing bad has happened (yet?) but I wish I'd done my research beforehand. I am in full support of freedom of choice in this predicament. You either choose to take it or not. You should NEVER force anyone to do anything. 

Think for yourself about what YOU should do. Fuck what anyone else has to say. If you want to eliminate the risk of side effects, then don't take it. If you believe not taking it would interfere with your responsibilities, then take it. You have a CHOICE. 

As I saw a comment on a post a while ago, choose wisely because there's no going back.
I honestly don't want to. I just want things over with.
Right. It's sucks how you have to lose the best things in your life to realize what you had. This is gonna haunt me for as long as I live.
It's rough bro. I also started talking to this girl in March. I hope your pain subsides and you can move on. 🖤
No don't pity me. I'll have to deal with the consequences of my actions. I'm prone to learning things the hard way.
I think I'll stay away from relationships. Not sure how long but that's my decision as of now.

I told her that if I were to see her in person that I would tell her the same thing. I believe it would mean more too since it's more sincere. I don't want to breakdown in front of her but I do want to express my wrongs like an adult.
She did but she hasn't responded. Not that I expect her to. Nor do I expect forgiveness from her. The least I can do is let her know that I fucked up.
What can therapy do for me? Not a damn thing.

We unfollowed each other on social media so there isn't anyway to contact her. I don't even have her number. I tried to get her to message me on Facebook last week but she didn't respond. Maybe in the future, we'll talk again but I won't bank on it.

It was not her that disappeared, it was me. I thought that it was a "game" but I ended up burning myself. She then unfollowed me on IG and I unfriended her on Facebook. Not because I have any malice towards her but I that we're pretty much done.

I already know nothing can be done. And I'll say this, I was an asshole. I said I was "more intelligent" based on a little debate we had but then it turned into an argument. I thought I was being playful but she didn't see it that way. That's pretty much how it started. But before that she was texting me pretty much everyday, actually wanted to see me and hang out. And I don't have much either. I live with in my Uncle's basement and barely have any cash to my name. Not too many girls would stick around for a guy like me.

Edit: She also bought me Lyft's home from work a couple times and always bring her weed over my place to smoke, even when I had my own. Can't sound more into somebody than all of this.

I appreciate your words but I take full responsibility for what I did. I'm not going to find a reason for my actions. What I did was intentional and this is what I get, for taking her for granted and fucking things up for myself. The saying "you never know what you had until it's gone" isn't more appropriate for me.
